title: Spikes at the primes
plain: Put a fixed bump at every prime on the half-line lattice. Prove the electron is localized at energies inside the free band, as it would be if the primes were random.
math: Let $H=\Delta+\lambda\mathbf 1_{\mathbb P}$ on $\ell^2(\mathbb N)$, $\lambda\ne0$. Prove that $H$ has pure point spectrum in $(-2,2)$.
